body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Los Angeles, United States. The listing gives its length as 1.5 – 2.5 hours, over a route of about 3 miles. It starts at The Broad, South Grand Avenue, 221. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Free timed-entry ticket to the Broad to guarantee entry (walk-up entry cannot be guaranteed). There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Alexandra as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore the highlights of one of the world's leading contemporary art museums and walk through downtown Los Angeles with your own in-app audio tour!
>
> Keep in mind that the Broad has a free (!) admission. By buying this audio tour, you don’t pay for your entry. However, you get an opportunity to explore the beauty of the museum at your own pace, following the carefully planned route and listening to amazing stories.
>
> The tour will start with an explanation of Broad's one-of-a-kind architecture, which will leave no one indifferent. Then, you will be guided through the highlights of the permanent collection such as works by Jeff Koons, Roy Lichtenstein, and J.M. Basquiat. No contemporary art exhibition can be complete without Andy Warhol, whose works and life will be interpreted on the tour.
>
> Next, you will walk through LA downtown with its magnificent skyline and architectural gems like Walt Disney Concert Hall. Chill out in the Grand Park and refocus on history and classical sculptures. Take a ride on Angel's Flight, the shortest railway in the world. Finish the tour at the Grand Central Market, a perfect place for a gastronomy adventure!
>
> Take this audio tour to discover the artists whose names are on everyone's lips and the vibrant downtown Los Angeles!
>
> This audio tour is not affiliated with the Broad Museum but is submitted by an individual creator. Free timed-entry ticket required by the Broad is included in the tour for customers' convenience.
